job_description:
Job Title: Senior Frontend / Full-Stack Developer
Department: Engineering
Location: Remote / Hybrid

About the Role:
We are seeking a talented Senior Frontend / Full-Stack Developer to design and build scalable, user-centric web applications. You will partner closely with product managers and designers to deliver high-quality software experiences.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build robust, accessible, and high-performance web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Architect and maintain backend services and REST APIs with Node.js and Express.
- Model data schemas and optimize database queries using SQL and PostgreSQL.
- Develop clean, modern, and responsive user interfaces with HTML/CSS and Tailwind CSS.
- Package applications with Docker and participate in modern CI/CD deployment pipelines.
- Maintain code reliability and test coverage through unit testing and integration testing.
- Collaborate in an Agile/Scrum team using Git/GitHub for branching, pull requests, and code reviews.

Required Qualifications & Skills:
- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.
- Expert knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript.
- Proven hands-on experience building production applications with React and Next.js.
- Strong proficiency in modern UI styling using HTML/CSS and Tailwind CSS.
- Solid server-side development experience with Node.js and REST APIs.
- Practical database experience with SQL (PostgreSQL or MySQL).
- Familiarity with containerization via Docker and CI/CD automation workflows.
- Experience with unit testing frameworks (e.g. Jest, Cypress).
- Version control fluency with Git/GitHub.
- Demonstrated communication, proactive problem solving, and cross-functional teamwork.
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical background.
